sources.text: curd inoculated with P. roqueforti, rind of P. camemberti; created 1951 near Servas; Brie-like creamy interior; ripening not stated

facts.v: First made in Bresse after World War II
Curd inoculated with Penicillium roqueforti; the outer coat is powdered Penicillium camemberti; creamy, Brie-like interior with blue patches
